purpose: Estimate whether rejection of a visit interpretation is a function of observation support rather than silently treating every low target score as biological absence.

analysis_unit.cluster_source: completed V15b prediction metadata bound to the sealed held-out truth join
analysis_unit.resampling_unit: actual day x physical scene cluster

comparison.contrast_interpretation: same T/C/N components; the contrast isolates the explicit observation-support gate and process-preserving triad decision

family.estimand: baseline minus full missed-visit-as-absence rate on resolved visit windows
full minus baseline retained-candidate recall on observable resolved visit windows
full censored fraction on truth-resolved unobservable support windows
full censored fraction on truth-resolved observable support windows

estimator.point_estimator: pooled numerator divided by pooled denominator across actual clusters
estimator.zero_denominator_rule: not_evaluable; never replace with a zero rate

decision_rule.supported: all four predeclared hypotheses meet their separately frozen thresholds
decision_rule.not_supported: all four are evaluable and at least one misses its threshold
decision_rule.not_evaluable: cluster or denominator support misses the separately frozen minimum; no family claim

claim_ceiling: Pre-field cluster-inference software contract only. A future supported family may establish the declared held-out observation-support claim for the sampled day x scene population; it cannot establish universal superiority, pollination effectiveness, or a biological absence claim for censored windows.
